onboard.note: S 1 along the Rhine, the Untersee and Lake Constance — Schlatt TG → Roggwil-Berg, the longest beer of the trip
Voralpen-Express Pfäffikon → Küssnacht: Biberbrugg, Rothenthurm, Arth-Goldau — all Schwyz
Brunnen → Göschenen up the Gotthard north ramp, past the Wassen church three times
Oberrüti → Aarau on the S 26 through the Freiamt — Muri, Wohlen, Lenzburg, Aarau — nearly the whole ride is Aargau
Hauenstein tunnel → Pratteln: Sissach, Liestal and the Ergolz valley
Delémont → La Chaux-d'Abel on the CJ through the Franches-Montagnes
Yverdon → Renens along Lake Neuchâtel and across the Gros-de-Vaud
Palézieux → Flamatt: Romont, Fribourg and the Saane bridges
Flamatt → Herzogenbuchsee through Bern — the last one, on the way home
